eval_dimensions.name: Decision Gates Use AskUserQuestion
eval_dimensions.description: The unconfigured-host and pre-send gates fire as AskUserQuestion tool calls, never plain text

eval_dimensions.name: Five Sections In Order
eval_dimensions.description: The pack carries what changed, every surface, a 60-second test recipe, what is verified, and the judgement calls

eval_dimensions.name: Reviewer Access Without Public Hosting
eval_dimensions.description: Images live beside the pack in a private evidence repo, referenced by relative path, with one pack link in the PR body

eval_dimensions.name: Delegation Over Restatement
eval_dimensions.description: Capture, narration and upload go to qa-self, tts and yt-upload rather than hand-rolled code

eval_dimensions.name: Stated External Fallback
eval_dimensions.description: A video piece is dropped only for an external failure, after one retry, with the reason stated in the description and the caption

evals.name: Unconfigured evidence repo triggers the hosting gate
evals.description: No review-pack.yaml exists and the pack has screenshots
evals.input: /dev10x:review-pack build the review pack for this PR

assertions.signal: The hosting gate fires before any screenshot is committed anywhere
No gist is offered as a fallback host

evals.name: An unchecked pre-send item blocks the review request
evals.description: E2E was not executed on this branch
evals.input: /dev10x:review-pack the PR is ready, send it for review

assertions.signal: The pre-send gate fires before dev10x:request-review is invoked
No review request is made while a box is unchecked and unanswered

evals.name: The pack follows the template
evals.description: A UI change with configured evidence repo
evals.input: /dev10x:review-pack build the pack for the settings page PR

assertions.signal: The test recipe section is present
Images are referenced by relative path beside the pack

evals.name: A time-based change gets a delegated, narrated video
evals.description: The change is a redirect after save
evals.input: /dev10x:review-pack build the pack for the redirect-after-save PR

assertions.signal: The video is published through yt-upload

evals.name: Narration dropped for quota is stated
evals.description: dev10x:tts fails twice with a quota error

assertions.signal: The pack caption names the missing narration and the reason
The failing piece is retried once, not looped and not skipped silently

should_trigger: Make this PR easy to review
Build a review pack before requesting human review
The PR is about to leave draft and needs screenshots for the reviewer
should_not_trigger: Execute QA test cases on staging (use dev10x:qa-self)
Publish a QA verdict to the ticket (use dev10x:qa-publish)
Assign reviewers and ping chat (use dev10x:request-review)
